name: נַפְתֻּחִים
summary: The Naphtuhim, a people descended from Mizraim, listed in both genealogies immediately after the Lehabim. Its derivation is unknown.

evidence.note: וְאֶת נַפְתֻּחִים introduces the fourth people whom Mizraim is said to have fathered.
The parallel genealogy names the Naphtuhim in the same position after the Lehabim.

note: Moved from the former word entry `napettu7iym`. נפתח recorded the consonantal stem of the gentilic. Its derivation is unknown.
